rendered: Water has the strongest hydrogen bonding of the solvents compared in the paper, with a δH of 42.3 MPa^1/2[1] (as plotted in Figure 6b[2]). EG, the solvent the paper uses for delamination, has a δH of 26.0[3]. Water is not used for delamination because it corrodes the aluminum foil: lithium leaching from the NMC cathode makes the water solution basic, so the aluminum corrosion would contaminate the NMC particles with aluminum hydroxide precipitates on the cathode surfaces.[4][5][6][7]
